lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.what: a reading light for the shelf: one small web page, kept in its own folder
lantern.compose:
services:
  lantern:
    image: ghcr.io/example/lantern:1.4.2@sha256:c5220b3c4266890f047190c18dc4243e0dac079d43ca8065899c4f9f3cf124ef
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      TZ: ${TZ}
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:8061"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA}:/data

fields.label: Its settings
fields.help: its own folder, which holds what it keeps

tidepool.name: Tidepool
tidepool.what: photos from every phone, with a database of its own beside it
tidepool.compose:
services:
  tidepool:
    image: ghcr.io/example/tidepool:2.0.1@sha256:ad6eaaed527d2071e865d190ad76cd2609c91ad8f396b1db927ef59012f74643
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      TZ: ${TZ}
      DB_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:8062"
    volumes:
      - ${LIBRARY}:/photos
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine@sha256:a761ddad11e149543ee1b071565452252099aae522171fda46ef56ce30540c25
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA}/db:/var/lib/postgresql/data

fields.label: Its database
fields.help: its own folder, which holds its database

fields.label: Its photos
fields.help: the share's folder what is uploaded is kept in

fields.label: Database password
fields.help: its database's own, made for it when left empty
